title: PM-USP CSSS Official Scheme Guidelines (CSSS_GUIDLINES_07022024_updated.pdf)
organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
extractedText: PRADHAN MANTRI UCHCHATAR SHIKSHA PROTSAHAN (PM-USP) YOJANA GUIDELINES FOR THE COMPONENT SCHEME – CENTRAL SECTOR SCHEME OF SCHOLARSHIP FOR COLLEGE AND UNIVERSITY STUDENTS (PM-USP CSSS) (Applicable for academic year 2022-23 onwards). 1. Objective: To provide financial assistance to meritorious students from economically weaker sections. 2. Allocation: 82,000 fresh scholarships per annum (41,000 for boys and 41,000 for girls) allocated state-wise based on population in age group 18-25. 3. Eligibility: Students above 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from the particular Board of Examination in Class XII. Pursuing regular courses from recognized colleges/institutions. Gross parental/family income ceiling is Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum. Income certificate required from fresh applicants only once. 4. Rate of Scholarship: Rs. 12,000/- per annum at Graduation level for first three years. Rs. 20,000/- per annum at Post Graduation level. For 5 year integrated courses Rs. 20,000/- per annum in 4th and 5th year. 5. Renewal Criteria: Student must secure at least 50% marks in annual examination and minimum 75% attendance. Must maintain good discipline and not indulge in ragging. 6. Restrictions: Student availing scholarship under this scheme shall not avail any other scholarship scheme including State run scholarship/fee waiver.

title: PM-USP CSSS Official Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ_DOHE_CSSS.pdf)
organization: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt. of India
extractedText: Government of India Ministry of Education Department of Higher Education (Scholarship Division). PM-USP CSSS FAQs 2025-26. Q1: Is One Time Registration (OTR) mandatory? Yes, OTR is mandatory for applying on NSP from AY 2024-25 onwards. Q2: Can a student apply for renewal if he/she changed college? Yes, student can change college in renewal application subject to verification by new institute. Q3: What documents are required for renewal? Student must upload marksheet showing minimum 50% marks and institute attendance verification certifying minimum 75% attendance. Q4: Is fresh income certificate required for renewal? No, income certificate is required only at the time of fresh application. Q5: How is scholarship disbursed? Exclusively through Aadhaar-seeded Bank Account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
